literal_meaning: ঘি লেপা, ঘোল ঢাকা (ghee smeared, curd covered)
figurative_meaning_en: A sign of contrary or foolish intelligence
similar_in_english: Shutting the barn door after the horse has bolted
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চুরির কথা সবাই জানে, এখনও ঘি আদুড়, ঘোল ঢাকা করে লুকোতে চাইছে।
ভুলটি ঘটে গেছে, এখন ঘি আদুড়, ঘোল ঢাকা করে কী লাভ?
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone knows about his theft, yet he's still trying to cover it up like ghee smeared, curd covered.
The mistake has already happened; now trying to hide it is just a sign of foolish thinking.
history: Originating from traditional Bengali rural practices involving dairy products like ghee and curd, symbolizing futile attempts to hide the obvious in daily life.
note: The idiom reflects the simplicity of rural Bengali household items to illustrate human folly.
